original.note: Wave 1 is answerable from .foreman-job/IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md line 14 (seven required dispositions) and line 24 (done when the named pytest gate passes and a test reaches the change). The listed production files implement those dispositions; this is not an unimplemented wave.

findings.message: Plan line 14 item 5: a Grok refresh must not repeat capabilities/help/disposable status inside observe. Refresh does pass its probe (provider_setup.py:160-161) into observe (provider_native.py:487). Sign-in does not. start_login refreshes, then native.login computes cap = self.capabilities(family) at provider_native.py:564 and calls self.observe(connection) at line 567 without that cap. observe line 487 therefore calls capabilities() again (help plus a disposable auth status) before grok_status. A transient raise on that second probe is NativeError, and the login worker at provider_setup.py:422-424 marks the attempt failed even though the refresh probe already succeeded. tests/test_provider_review_followup.py::test_grok_refresh_reuses_one_capability_probe_and_qualifies_account never calls login().
